slides.title: Din Framtid Väntar
slides.prompt: Get inspirational closing message in Swedish. In one sentence, explain how the portfolio is changing the world for the better, with concrete examples of products. Do not mention specific brands, keep it slightly generic. Take into account the 50 most important companies in the portfolio. Write in a way that feels sincere and personal to the reader. In addition, include 8 emojis to summarize the 50 most important companies in the portfolio. Do not include emojis that show people. Use emojis that can work with the whole portfolio, not just a single company. Do not include emojis that only highlight increased portfolio value. Add a series of 6 Swedish words to summarize the same 50 companies.  Use words that can work with the whole portfolio, not just a single company. Do not include words that only highlight portfolio performance. Only output the 6 words.

data.message: När du reflekterar över den positiva inverkan denna anmärkningsvärda portfölj har haft, kom ihåg att det inte bara handlar om avkastning; det handlar om att främja banbrytande innovationer – som att förenkla sjukvården, främja hållbara transporter och förbättra kommunikationstekniken – som tillsammans bidrar till en bättre och mer uppkopplad värld.
